# CodeBlock

`import { CodeBlock } from "@/components/agent-ui/code-block"`

## Use for
- Source code or a unified diff inside an assistant answer.

## Do not use for
- A syntax-highlighting theme. Pass already-highlighted nodes through the project's highlighter, or leave the text plain.
- Tool arguments and raw JSON. Those stay inside `ToolCall`.
- A whole file the user will edit. Use `Artifact` and put a `CodeBlock` in its panel.

## Props
| Prop | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `string` | Required. The exact text the copy button writes. |
| `language` | `string` | Shown as a label, not used to color tokens. |
| `filename` | `string` | Optional path in the header. |
| `diff` | `boolean` | Colors lines that start with `+` or `-`. Do not color `+++` or `---`. |
| `copyLabel` / `copiedLabel` | `string` | Accessible name of the copy button. Set them when the interface is not in English. |

## Example
```tsx
<CodeBlock
  filename="src/settings/SettingsPage.tsx"
  language="diff"
  diff
  code={patch}
  copyLabel="Copy"
  copiedLabel="Copied"
/>
```

## Rules
- Render it as a sibling of `Message`, not inside a fenced markdown block that you also style yourself.
- Do not add a color prop. Added and removed lines use the primary and destructive tokens.
